2026_01_GB_MIN.headline: Green Bay’s depleted front meets Minnesota’s rebuilt passing attack
2026_01_GB_MIN.paragraph1: Green Bay heads to Minnesota without Josh Jacobs and Micah Parsons, removing major pieces from both sides of the ball. The Packers still have Jordan Love, but an inexperienced backfield must produce enough efficiency to keep Minnesota’s rush from controlling obvious passing downs. The Vikings are trying to restore their passing game and can lean on Justin Jefferson while stressing Green Bay’s thinner defensive front. Inside a loud divisional road environment, protection communication, run-game efficiency and the ability to generate explosives without inviting negative plays should decide the matchup.
2026_01_GB_MIN.model_rationale: Minnesota can attack Green Bay’s missing star power and home-field environment, while the Packers need composed protection and efficient early downs to keep the game structurally balanced.
